description: On habits, restraint and mastering the mind.

items.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
items.author: Will Durant

translations.en: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
translations.hi: हम वही हैं जो हम बार-बार करते हैं; श्रेष्ठता अभ्यास है, कर्म नहीं।

items.summary_1line: Excellence is a habit, not an event.
items.summary_2to3line: Character is built from repetition, not from single heroic acts. Small consistent choices compound into who you become.
items.bodh_3to4line: Stop waiting to feel excellent and start repeating small good acts. Motivation is unreliable; habit is durable. Design your day so the right action is the easy default.

items.text: Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.
items.author: Attributed to Jim Rohn

translations.en: Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.
translations.hi: अनुशासन लक्ष्य और उपलब्धि के बीच का पुल है।

items.summary_2to3line: A goal is only a wish until discipline carries it across. The gap between wanting and having is closed by daily structure.
items.bodh_3to4line: Goals set direction; discipline supplies movement. When you feel far from a goal, the missing piece is rarely desire - it is a routine you can keep on a bad day.

items.text: The first and greatest victory is to conquer yourself.
items.author: Attributed to Plato

translations.en: The first and greatest victory is to conquer yourself.
translations.hi: सबसे पहली और सबसे बड़ी विजय स्वयं पर विजय है।

items.summary_1line: Mastering yourself is the first victory.
items.summary_2to3line: Every external conquest is smaller than the internal one. Restraint over one's own impulses is the foundation of all other strength.
items.bodh_3to4line: Notice how much of your day is spent obeying your own impulses. Each time you pause and choose deliberately, you win a small internal battle that quietly strengthens the whole.

items.text: He who conquers himself is the mightiest warrior.
items.author: Attributed to Confucius

translations.en: He who conquers himself is the mightiest warrior.
translations.hi: जो स्वयं को जीतता है वही सबसे महान योद्धा है।

items.summary_2to3line: Strength measured by force is shallow. The person who governs their own reactions holds the deepest kind of power.
items.bodh_3to4line: Anger, craving and fear are the real opponents. Defeating them requires no audience and no applause, which is exactly why it is harder and more valuable.

items.text: Rule your mind or it will rule you.
items.author: Attributed to Horace

translations.en: Rule your mind or it will rule you.
translations.hi: मन पर शासन करो, वरना मन तुम पर शासन करेगा।

items.summary_1line: Either you govern your mind or it governs you.
items.summary_2to3line: An untended mind defaults to reactivity. Attention and intention are what turn it from a master into a servant.
items.bodh_3to4line: The mind is an excellent tool and a poor master. Give it clear tasks and quiet periods, and it serves you; leave it idle and it will manufacture problems to chew on.
